display.purpose: The name in the ring's hole on the home, lowercase, fog-white, sized to the hole.

headline.purpose: Section and page titles, lowercase, signal green.

title.purpose: Row titles and group titles, bold.

body.purpose: Running text and statements (the about statement is lowercase, through CSS); blog prose steps up to 1.125rem at 68ch.

label.purpose: HUD labels and data only: menu and nav labels, the bottom edge, dates, tags, inline code.

shadows.name: button-drop
shadows.purpose: Soft dark drop under the primary button; deepens on hover. Never coloured.

shadows.name: frame-drop
shadows.purpose: Quiet seat under the resume PDF frame and the planner screenshot.

shadows.name: canvas-bloom
shadows.value: additive compositing ('lighter') of the ring's hairlines in the canvas
shadows.purpose: The only glow in the system; it lives inside the ring, never in CSS.

motion.name: ease-out-expo
motion.purpose: Button lift, label slide, arrow nudge.

motion.name: state-fast
motion.purpose: Colour, fill and underline transitions on hover.

motion.name: ring-intro
motion.purpose: The weave and the dial draw themselves in on load.

motion.name: ring-exit
motion.value: 0.56s unravel on the canvas: inner corners spin and pull in, strings let go in a shuffled order, the dial spins away; the name's letters scatter and the labels slide off
motion.purpose: Choosing a label unravels the ring before the next page loads (after lhbzr.com).

motion.name: ring-breath
motion.value: 0.045 rad/s turn with slow twist and spread drift
motion.purpose: The ring's idle motion; stopped by the motion toggle and by reduced motion.

motion.name: ring-pacing
motion.value: 30fps idle, up to 60fps while the pointer, a label or the intro moves it
motion.purpose: Keeps the ring smooth and light; a governor lowers resolution (2x, 1.5x, 1x), then frame rate, when frames arrive late.

motion.name: ring-return
motion.value: 0.9s, the exit in reverse: the ring weaves back together, the letters gather, the labels slide in; the page left recedes to 94% (to-menu view transition type)
motion.purpose: Coming back to the main menu from another page of the site.

motion.name: page-leave
motion.value: 0.22s, the old page lifts 14px and fades (cross-document view transition); the header holds still
motion.purpose: Moving between pages without a crossfade; the new page prints itself in.

motion.name: print-in
motion.value: title wipe behind a 2px scan line (0.7s); words light up in reading order, signal-strong cooling to their colour (0.56s each); lists wipe in 70ms apart, capped at six
motion.purpose: Inner pages arrive like a readout; section rules draw out from their tick (1.2s) as they scroll in.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: No view transition, a still ring, a still wave, no toggle.

breakpoints.name: nav-grid
breakpoints.value: 359px (max) : the six nav labels become a 3 x 2 grid

breakpoints.name: nav-phone
breakpoints.value: 479px (max) : nav labels tighten to 0.78rem to stay on one row

breakpoints.name: home-stack
breakpoints.value: 819px (max) or 560px tall (max) : the home becomes one column: ring on top, name inside, then labels, bottom edge

breakpoints.name: resume-split
breakpoints.value: 1000px : PDF frame up to 52rem beside a summary rail of 16rem to 24rem (touch devices drop the frame)

narrative.overview:
The site is what a pair of HUD glasses would show, and its home is the menu screen you would boot into: a woven neon ring turning slowly on a near-black field of faint green dots, the owner's name, pitch and role held in the ring's hole, and six bracketed labels pointing at it from either side. Nothing scrolls on the home; it is a single instrument face that says who this is and offers the next move. Inner pages keep the same ground, the same signal and the same bracket language, and read like readouts: hairline rules, ruled rows, short facts.

The ring is the signature and the only big image. It is string art: each of 128 triangles has one corner on an inner circle and two on an outer one, and the rotated copies weave into a torus. It breathes, turns, bends and brightens toward the pointer, lights the side facing a hovered label, and unravels before the next page loads. It is drawn on a canvas in the page's own signal colour; an inline SVG of the same ring stands in before the script runs.

Green is spent freely, by owner decision, but the name and body copy stay fog-white so green keeps its meaning: titles, links, labels, state, data and the ring. There are no photographs: the owner retired the forest ground and the street footage when the site became technological.
keyCharacteristics: One neon green signal on a near-black green ground with a faint dot grid; hairlines and ticks are tinted with it.
The home is a one-viewport main menu: the ring, the name in its hole, three labels each side, a quiet bottom edge.
Atkinson Hyperlegible for words; system monospace for HUD labels and data.
Lowercase headings, labels and nav; sentence case in running text.
Ruled rows and hairlines instead of cards; depth from tone, glow only inside the canvas.
Motion is purposeful and always stoppable: a motion toggle, and reduced motion yields a still ring.

rules.name: The Green Is Spent Rule
rules.body: Green marks titles, links, labels, state, data and the ring. The name and body copy stay fog-white; if everything is green nothing is.

rules.name: The Tinted Neutral Rule
rules.body: No neutral gray and no pure black or white in the UI. Hairlines and dots are signal at low alpha; fog is tinted toward 150 hue.

rules.name: The No Photo Ground Rule
rules.body: The ground is the dot field: a 28px grid of 1px signal dots at 20% under a soft vignette, fixed behind every page. No photograph, video or texture sits behind the content.

rules.name: The Mono Is Data Rule
rules.body: Monospace appears only for HUD labels and data: menu and nav labels, the bottom edge, dates, tags, inline code. Fact-list terms are Atkinson bold in signal-dim, never mono.

rules.name: The Lowercase Voice Rule
rules.body: The name, headings, labels, nav, buttons, wordmark and the about statement are lowercase. The statement is lowered in CSS, so its source keeps LSU and I for screen readers. The pitch line stays verbatim where it appears (the home's page title).

rules.name: The Canvas Glow Rule
rules.body: Light comes from the ring itself, through additive compositing in the canvas. CSS shadows are dark, low and tinted toward the ground.

dos: Do keep the home a one-viewport menu: the ring, the name and what he does in its hole, three labels each side, and the bottom edge.
Do spend `signal` on titles, labels, links, tags, dates, icons, selection, caret, focus and the ring, and keep the name and body copy fog-white.
Do keep every neutral tinted toward green and every hairline a low-alpha signal.
Do keep monospace to HUD labels and data, and Atkinson (bold in signal-dim) for fact-list terms.
Do build lists as ruled rows, and keep headings, labels and nav lowercase.
Do keep every target at 44px or more with a 3px signal focus ring, and give any looping motion a pause control and a reduced-motion still.
Do draw the canvas in the page's `--signal` so the ring and the CSS are the same green.
donts: Don't put a photograph, video or texture behind the content; the ground is the dot field.
Don't reintroduce amber or any second accent; the signal is one green.
Don't add coloured CSS glows or hard offset shadows; light belongs to the canvas.
Don't turn the home into a scrolling landing page or put anything in the ring's hole but the name.
Don't set body copy or the name in green, or set fact-list terms in mono.
Don't use cards as the page structure.
